plain_description: **Protect your AI applications from prompt injection attacks.** Rebuff checks incoming prompts and detects when canary words leak from prompts.
technical_description: Rebuff is a prototype prompt injection detector with layered defenses: input heuristics, LLM-based detection, vector database comparisons against prior attacks, and canary tokens for detecting prompt leakage. It provides JavaScript/TypeScript and Python SDKs. The README shows setup with OpenAI and Pinecone; self-hosting the playground also uses Supabase and a vector database.
title: Rebuff
